entry.description: Switch the motor from the enabled state.

entry.description: Switch the motor from disabled state to enabled state.

entry.description: Stop the motor without clearing its running state. Motor can be controlled again by sending control commands.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_OPEN_LOOP_CONTROL
entry.param: data type float, Range -850~850 (Motor current and torque varies by motor).

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_TORQUE_CLOSED_LOOP_CONTROL
entry.param: data type float ,The torque current output value range of the motor is -2048~2048, corresponding to the actual torque current range of -16.5A~16.5A for MF motors and -33A~33A for MG motors. The bus current and actual torque vary by motor.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_SPEED_CLOSED_LOOP_CONTROL
entry.param: Data type float, control the motor speed, the corresponding actual speed is 0.01dps/LSB.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_MULTI_TURN_POSITION_CLOSED_LOOP_CONTROL_1
entry.param: corresponding to actual position is 0.01degree/LSB, i.e. 36000 represents 360/deg. Motor rotation direction is determined by the difference between target position and current position.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_MULTI_TURN_POSITION_CLOSED_LOOP_CONTROL_2
entry.param: Data type float, control the motor speed, the corresponding actual speed is 0.01dps/LSB.
Control value maxSpeed limits the maximum motor rotation speed, float type, corresponding to actual speed 0.01dps/LSB.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_SINGLE_TURN_POSITION_CLOSED_LOOP_CINTROL_1
entry.description: Single turn position closed loop control.
entry.param: Motor rotation direction, see MOTOR_DIRECTION_CONTROL enum
Control value angleControl is float type, value range 0~35999, corresponding to actual position is 0.01degree/LSB, actual angle range 0°~359.99°

entry.name: MAV_CMD_MOTOR_SINGLE_TURN_POSITION_CLOSED_LOOP_CINTROL_2
entry.description: Single turn position closed loop control.

Control value angleControl is float type, value range 0~35999, corresponding to actual position is 0.01degree/LSB, actual angle range 0°~359.99°
Control value maxSpeed limits the maximum motor rotation speed, float type, corresponding to actual speed 0.01dps/LSB.
